item.title: Malaysia bans e-waste imports, vows to end illegal dumping
item.description: Malaysia has announced a full ban on importing electronic waste to tighten controls on hazardous materials and protect the environment.

item.title: Herricks house fire sends 1 to hospital, Nassau County fire officials say
item.description: The fire broke out at a two-story home on Foch Boulevard, according to Nassau County fire officials.

item.title: No. 20 West Virginia women beat Colorado 61-55
item.description: Jordan Harrison scores 18 points as No. 20 West Virginia beats Colorado 61-55 on Wednesday night.

item.title: No. 5 Illinois makes 17 3-pointers, beats Northwestern 84-44 for 12th straight win
item.description: Andrej Stojakovic scored 17 points and No. 5 Illinois made 17 3-pointers in an 84-44 win over Northwestern.

item.title: Taiwan-US ties are 'rock solid,' the island's president says after Trump-Xi call
item.description: Taiwan's ties with the United States are "rock solid," the island's president said Thursday, hours after President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping spoke on the phone, including about the self-ruled island's future.

item.title: Roy scores 30 and Oklahoma State overcomes big game from Dybantsa to beat No. 16 BYU 99-92
item.description: Anthony Roy scored a season-high 30 points, leading Oklahoma State to a 99-92 victory over 16th-ranked BYU.

item.title: Emergency crews evacuate patients and battle blaze at Pennsylvania hospital
item.description: Officials say emergency crews battled a blaze and evacuated patients from a hospital in Pennsylvania as fire engulfed part of the facility.

item.title: Utah beats Detroit 4-1 for 8th win in last 10 home games
item.description: Nick Schmaltz and Clayton Keller had a goal and an assist each, Karel Vejmelka made 29 saves, and the Utah Mammoth beat the Detroit Red Wings 4-1.

item.title: Otega Oweh goes for 20-plus again and Kentucky defeats Oklahoma 94-78
item.description: Otega Oweh matched his season-high with 24 points, Brandon Garrison had 20 points and 11 rebounds off the bench, and Kentucky defeated Oklahoma 94-78.

item.title: No. 2 UCLA women rout Rutgers 86-46 for 16th straight win
item.description: Kiki Rice scored 17 points and No. 2 UCLA routed Rutgers 86-46.
